definitions.explanation: Demand for goods and services from outside the country — essentially exports. An economic term contrasted with domestic demand.

examples.japanese: {外需|がいじゅ}が{伸|の}びている。
{日本|にほん}{経済|けいざい}は{外需|がいじゅ}に{大|おお}きく{依存|いぞん}している。
examples.english: The Japanese economy depends heavily on foreign demand.

examples.japanese: {外需|がいじゅ}の{減少|げんしょう}を{補|おぎな}うため、{政府|せいふ}は{内需|ないじゅ}{拡大|かくだい}{策|さく}を{打|う}ち{出|だ}した。
examples.english: To compensate for the decline in foreign demand, the government introduced measures to expand domestic demand.

notes:
USAGE:
An economics term frequently seen in news and business reporting. Contrasted with {内需|ないじゅ} (domestic demand). In economic analysis, {外需|がいじゅ} primarily refers to the net exports component of GDP.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {外需|がいじゅ}{依存|いぞん}: dependence on external demand
- {外需|がいじゅ}{主導|しゅどう}: led by external demand
- {外需|がいじゅ}の{拡大|かくだい}: expansion of external demand
- {外需|がいじゅ}と{内需|ないじゅ}: external and domestic demand
